issues.notes: upgrade-only. What breaks: every CBScript pack a player wished before 1.21.11 has 'gamerule maxCommandChainLength 1000000000' in its reset function (the compiler's boilerplate). 1.21.11 replaced the camelCase game-rule names with registry ids (Mojang's GameRuleRegistryFix: max_command_sequence_length), so that line is an unknown command, and one unparseable line fails the whole function to load: the pack's state is not reset/initialised. Stored data: the installed wished packs in a world's datapacks folder and the mod's own pack store (DatapackStore). New packs compiled on 1.21.11 (moddy-cbscript mc/1.21.11) are not affected. Workaround: wish the power again on 1.21.11 (recompiles the pack). A fix would be a versioned rename on install (DatapackDialect.correctFunction), deliberately not built (owner: no upgrade-only work). Unverified: found by reading the 1.21.11 command tree and the compiler's output; not yet reproduced in a world upgraded from 1.21.10. Verify by: on 1.21.10, wish a power (any CBScript pack), save; open the world on the 1.21.11 jar; /reload and check the server log for the pack's reset function failing to parse at 'gamerule maxCommandChainLength'.
issues.title: Upgrade-only (1.21.11): a datapack wished before 1.21.11 fails to load its reset function (old game-rule name)
